name: Touchstone Reviews
author: developercrack

sections.description:
Review anything, from trail shoes to software, in a review box that looks like it was designed for your site.

Touchstone Reviews gives every review a polished score box, writes the Google review schema for it, and keeps every review on your site in one dashboard. It is built for people who test things and write about them: review blogs, affiliate sites and magazines.

Why reviewers choose it

  • It looks right from the first review. The box picks up your theme’s fonts and colors on install, so it fits your site before you change a setting.
  • You control the look. Choose from 3 layouts and 7 color palettes, show scores as stars, bars or numbers, and set your own accent color, font and spacing.
  • Your scores, your way. Score out of 5, 10 or 100, with decimals such as 8.5, and use your own criteria for each kind of review.
  • Search ready. It creates valid Google review schema for products, books, films, software and games, and tells you when a score would make it invalid.
  • One dashboard for every review. See each review’s score, category and article, and find the ones that still need something.
  • Brings your old reviews along. Import from your old review plugin, check every review in a preview first, and undo if you change your mind.

Write your first review in four steps

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Open a post and add the Review box block.
  3. Name what you reviewed, score it, and add pros and cons. The preview updates as you type.
  4. Publish.

Find all your reviews under Reviews in the dashboard. Change the look under Reviews, Style, with a live preview on desktop and phone.

Tested before it ships

  • Security review
  • Keyboard and screen reader tested
  • Plugin Check: 0 errors
  • Fresh install with debugging on: 0 warnings
  • Run on a real review site with 51 reviews

Also included

  • The block editor, the classic editor and a [touchstone_review] shortcode all use the same review
  • A reviews list block for sidebars and “best of” pages
  • Review categories that remember your criteria for the next review
  • A verdict, a summary and a buy button with your own label and an affiliate note
  • Fast pages: no script is added, and the small stylesheet loads only where a review appears
  • Translation ready and right-to-left ready
  • Reviews are saved as normal WordPress content and stay in your database if you remove the plugin

Source code

The block editor scripts in build/ are compiled from the readable source in the blocks/ folder, which ships with the plugin. To build them yourself: npm install, then npm run build (Node 22).
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins, Add New, search for “Touchstone Reviews”, then Install and Activate.
  2. Open a post and add the “Review box” block.
  3. Fill in the review. Publish.

Classic editor? Fill in the “Review box” under the editor and add [touchstone_review] where it should appear.
sections.faq:
Will my reviews show stars in Google?

Your reviews get the schema Google asks for, and the plugin tells you if anything is missing. Google decides whether to show stars. It does not show them for reviews of your own business or products.

What can I review?

Anything: products, books, films, software, games, places or services. Pick a category or make your own criteria.

Does it work with my theme?

Yes. The box takes your theme’s fonts and colors. Change anything under Reviews, Style.

Can visitors leave ratings?

No. This plugin is for your own reviews, not customer ratings.

Can I bring my reviews from another plugin?

Yes, from WP Review, the review blocks of Spectra, Otter Blocks and Ultimate Blocks, and Taqyeem. Reviews, Import shows what it found before saving anything, and your old data is never changed.

What happens to my reviews if I delete the plugin?

They stay in your database unless you choose to delete them in the settings first.

Is there a Pro version?

No. Every feature described here is in this free plugin.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • New: import reviews from the review blocks of Otter Blocks, Spectra and Ultimate Blocks, with a preview first and undo.
  • New: the optional last import step can swap the old review block for the Review box block, and undo puts the old block back exactly as it was.

1.0.0

  • First public version.
